areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Gender action plan directly aligned; SMART housing-equity indicator with high impact potential; but no significant resources specifically allocated to the area.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Strongly aligned, with consistent technical structure; nearly all resources go to the area; flood mitigation, nature-based solutions and public spaces; high impact potential.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Strong adherence through ecological recovery, nature-based solutions and measurable indicators; positive impacts, though not top level.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Components target risk mitigation and resilience, including a climate plan; almost all resources, shared with other areas; high impact potential, level C assigned.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Only one product (a heritage square design) relates; no indicators or targets and a small resource share (under 10%) reduce impact.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: No components, indicators or targets; only a discreet link through a gender action plan, insufficient for points.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: No correlation with objectives, components, indicators, targets or resources.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Broad social-inclusion actions only; no specific objectives, indicators, components or resources on racial equality.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Green leisure spaces might encourage activity, but no product, indicator, target or resource ties directly to the area.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: No objectives, products, indicators or resources on employment or productive inclusion.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: No significant energy security, clean-source or efficiency actions; sustainable housing is localised and minor.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Gender and socioeconomic equity mentions lack territorial approach; no indicators, products or resources on regional inequality.
